suggestions.rationale: 199k claims missed ~202k but stayed under 200k; payrolls decide the path.

suggestions.headline: Keep China trade strength separate from import-miss / friction sleeve
suggestions.trigger: Follow-through export weakness or more cyber/AD headlines hit ADRs.
suggestions.invalidator: Export double-digits hold with ADR breadth improving.
suggestions.rationale: +23.9% exports is the support; import miss and Palo Alto/Malaysia AD are the offsets.

suggestions.headline: Fade Broad China beta from DeepSeek/Unitree headlines alone
suggestions.trigger: Financing/IPO headlines lift only a narrow AI/humanoid basket.
suggestions.invalidator: Funding closes with broad Golden Dragon breadth.
suggestions.rationale: Chart-of-day financing surge is YTD to Jul 13 — not a full-year print.

suggestions.headline: Fade BTC strength that only copies equities
suggestions.trigger: BTC rallies with equities while mid-$60ks lag narrative holds.
suggestions.invalidator: Rising spot volume with sustained BTC breakout.
suggestions.rationale: Weak continuing signal — boredom lag, not a new crypto regime.
